title: Launch attestation, exact identity and assigned-item entry
summary: Verified native death before work fails a registered launch immediately, including before acknowledgement; durable evidence records the reached phase, exit code and stderr tail, and the requester is notified. A delayed original worker can register or acknowledge after timeout without a time cap when no retry, cancellation, rebound, replacement launch or other active item claim has taken over. Recovery restores the receipt, gives a fresh deadline and records accepted_late; contested workers receive launch_taken_over and stop without claiming. Authenticated binding records harness_sessions.launch_origin=yoke; unbound sessions default operator. That persisted origin survives launch-history retention and gates native resume together with surface authority. Hand-started sessions receive messages at their next hook and trigger an operator-wake notice.
